cross_verification.note_en: The official Zimbabwe eVisa Platform (evisa.gov.zw, operated by the Department of Immigration) was checked directly - its homepage and complete FAQ page contain zero photo specifications (no size, background, format, or restriction language of any kind, confirmed via live browser render, not just a static fetch). Its 'Brochure.pdf' guide returns an S3 AccessDenied error, and the in-app application form (evisa.gov.zw/app) sits behind a required account sign-up, so it could not be inspected further without creating an account, which was not attempted per policy.
cross_verification.partial_text_found: Two separate official Zimbabwean embassy pages that list visa (port-of-entry) document checklists - Embassy of Zimbabwe to the USA (zimembassydc.org/visa-information/) and the Zimbabwean Embassy in New Delhi, India (zimnewdelhi.gov.zw/services/, 'Visa Information' subsection) - both describe the visa photo requirement only as '2 passport size photos', with no cm/mm figure, background color, or any restriction language restated for the visa category specifically.
cross_verification.db_relationship: The DB's existing size (3.5 x 4.5cm), background (white), and head-height (3.2-3.6cm) values are identical to what IS explicitly confirmed for the separate zw-passport category on the same official pages (see zw-passport.json) - but since no official source restates those numbers under the Visa section itself, this file does not assert them as confirmed for zw-visa, nor does it flag them as contradicted. They are left unverified per the truthfulness gate rather than assumed to carry over from the passport spec.
